text:
Maya: Quick sync — proposal to migrate quant/precision profile storage from JSON -> protobuf v2 to get proper schema evolution and smaller payloads. Thoughts?
Alex: +1 on schema evolution. Main tradeoffs: binary = smaller/faster, but loses diffs and ad-hoc edits in git. Also toolchain impact for ops/devs.
Chen: Runtime side: deserialization cost matters on cold-start. Proto parsing is fast in C++/Go, but Python runtime needs native libs. We should benchmark decode latency for 128k profile sets.
Sam: Could we support dual-format during rollout? runtime negotiates via header: "Precision-Profile-Version: v2" and falls back to v1 JSON. That reduces cutover risk.
Priya: Rollout plan idea: migrate profiles by customer in batches, run shadow comparison of outputs. Define canary criteria: degscore delta < 0.02 across our eval set, memory delta within 3%, no latency p95 increase > 5ms.
Maya: Good. Also need tooling: a migrator that does dry runs and emits diffs. Example CLI: `rwmigrate quant-profiles --from json --to proto --dry-run --sample 1000`.
Alex: Additional ergonomics: keep a human-readable JSON wrapper for CI diffs: store proto bytes in base64 but keep a `profile.json` for README-style inspection? Or generate `schema.yaml` for human review.
Chen: Runtime interface boundary: we should add a thin adapter layer in Serving that accepts either protobuf or JSON and normalizes to internal Profile object. That isolates changes.
Sam: Flagging ops concerns: S3 index update + consistency guarantees. When we flip a profile to proto, we must ensure atomic rename or put+manifest update to avoid partial reads.
Priya: Telemetry hooks: add a regression event that logs `profile_migration` with fields: profile_id, old_checksum, new_checksum, sample_degscores (list), latency_stats. We can create a dashboard to monitor.
Maya: Decision proposal: adopt protobuf v2 as canonical on disk, support JSON v1 for a 30-day compatibility window, runtime reorders to prefer v2 when header present, and add migrator + canary policy. Action items: 1) PR for schema (Alex), 2) migrator CLI (Sam), 3) runtime adapter (Chen), 4) telemetry + dashboard (Priya).
Alex: One more: include a stable versioned field in the proto: `uint32 schema_version = 1;` and `repeated string notes = 10;` so ops can annotate why a conversion happened.
Chen: I'll prototype adapter with metrics: parse_time, parse_success, fallback_reason. Will add unit tests for cross-format parity on longctx cases.
Sam: ops-bot: :warning: Canary group creation started for profile-migration-cg-01. 10% traffic, 48h window.
Priya: I'll prepare the eval harness to run nightly parity on the canary cohort and alert if degscore > 0.03 for any endpoint.
Maya: Great. If no objections by EOD we'll merge the schema RFC and schedule kickoff Monday. :thumbsup:
